title: Prior Authorization Outcome and the Genetic Cancellation Handling Fee
content:
The prior-authorization status of a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class lowers its genetic cancellation handling fee where the patient has an active coverage on file with Insurance Coverage & Claims.

- When the accession's prior-authorization status is *denied* and the patient has an active coverage on file, **15.00** is subtracted from the handling fee.
- When its prior-authorization status is *pending* and the patient has an active coverage on file, **5.00** is subtracted from the handling fee.
- Any other accession has nothing subtracted for authorization.

| Prior-authorization status on the accession | Active coverage on file | Subtracted from the handling fee |
|---|---|---|
| Denied | Yes | 15.00 |
| Pending | Yes | 5.00 |
| Denied or pending | No | nothing |
| Approved | Either | nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** A patient whose only coverage has ended cancels a genetic accession whose prior authorization had been denied. With no active coverage on file, nothing is subtracted for authorization.
